_comment: Parity corpus for the event-category derivation (event-truth arc P3, 2026-10-13). TWO readers run EVERY case: scripts/check-event-truth-v1.mjs --self-test (its own deriveGenres(sectionKinds, itemTypes, addedSessions) + categoryAgrees) and src/lib/__tests__/eventCategory.parity.test.ts (the canonical src/lib/eventCategory.ts: deriveCategories(format, [...sectionKinds, ...addedSessions kinds], [...itemTypes, ...addedSessions types]) + categoryAgrees). A shared file rather than an import because vitest cannot load the guard's .mjs. expect.set is in the lib's stable order: party, class, masterclass. Mutating ONE side's mapping reds that side alone -- that asymmetry is the proof the two are compared, not copied. addedSessions are date-only sessions (event_occurrence_added_session_p5 section_kind + type), the only sessions a new organiser-created series has.

cases.name: a party section with no item is a party
a social section is a party (synonym)
a social ITEM is a party (as get_latest_events_v2 counts it)
a classes section with a class item is a class
a section kind of class (not the enum's classes) still maps
a workshop item is a class, and a stored workshop agrees
a masterclass section is a class AND a masterclass
a masterclass item with a stored class agrees (the Classes tab lists it)
a night is party AND class; stored party is kept (keep-if-agrees)
the same night with stored class is also kept (keep-if-agrees pair)
a festival with classes one day and the party another is both
a course of class sessions stored party DISAGREES (the prod defect)
stored masterclass over class-only sessions disagrees
stored workshop over a party-only programme disagrees
a stored NULL with mapped sessions agrees with nothing (the mirror is unset)
a token outside the CHECK vocabulary disagrees, never a skip
unknown kinds and types say nothing
null and empty-string tokens say nothing
date-only ONLY: one class session, no series programme (the organiser create)
date-only ONLY: the same class session stored party disagrees
date-only: a party by TYPE alone (kind null) is a party
date-only: a classes section kind with a masterclass type is class AND masterclass
date-only: a social type is a party
date-only: performance / showcase map to nothing
date-only: a null/null session says nothing
series classes plus a date-only party is the UNION; stored class is kept
series party plus a date-only workshop is the UNION; stored party is kept
